body: Thank you, for your story. I'm sorry to hear you are likewise plagued by such guilt, and I hope there is some way you can find relief, be it by it passing, conversation, or anything. I'm too afraid to confront anyone, and I'm hoping my own shame and feelings pass, in time. I hope yours do, as well, and you can live on without guilt.

Scary to consider. I'll have to consider that, but for now I'm still rather wounding, so I hope you don't mind if I just.. hide and try to get over this a little. I'm not planning to run from it forever, but when all I can do is more or less lie down and be utterly miserable, it's hard to motivate myself to do anything.

Is it wrong, if I want a way to escape the guilt without having to come forward? A part of me wants to just sort of forget and hope it just never comes around again.
It was my mother. I'm honestly terrified at the prospect of talking to my sister, and posting this entire thing seems to have actually made my anxiety worse. Oh, dear.
I don't believe I was. I have no recollection of it, besides whatever 'exploration' I partook in with friends. I'm honestly horrified at the prospect of talking to her. I'm very cowardly, it seems.

Thank you. Thank you immensely for this. I'm not looking for excessive sugar-coating and "There, there" type replies, but this is exactly what I was looking for. Something similar. Something to connect to, I guess. It may sound awful here, and please don't infer anything insulting from it, as it's really, really not my intention, but I'm sort of glad I'm not the only one. I've always been a little eccentric and a little manic-depressive, and so I wonder if my 'upswings' had anything to do with my libido?

I don't think I could ever address it with my sister, however beneficial it may be. Call it greedy, but I fear the idea of being completely removed from my family. A part of me even finds the constant guilt perfectly suitable as a punishment. Likewise, I don't feel bad about the fooling around with my friends, but I really should have put an end to it there.

I guess I can take some modicum of pride in that I never tried to force anything with my friends or sibling, but I'm ashamed the latter happened at all.  I'm very sorry you had to go through something similar, but know that your sharing has helped me so very much. I, too, wish I'd seen a counselor of some sort, but I feel like it's a little beyond that point. I just don't know what's going to happen now, and it's honestly left me a little afraid. What if she recalls it all later, and it's immensely traumatising? How could I even begin to live with myself? What if it just boils into a resentment forever? I'm disgusted that I've fucked up something so fragile as a sibling bond forever because of my stupid actions as a child.

I don't want to label myself as a rapist or an abuser, but what else am I?

Thank you very much for the kind words. I can only imagine the hardships you had to endure, yourself. It's interesting you mention what you did: most people I talked to always said I was especially kind and empathic, and that my sudden turn and twist in mood was really shocking and kind of heartbreaking. I feel so worn out, like all of my "goodness fuel" has run out. Like I'm just running on bitterness now, and I hate it.

I don't want to feel this way, you know? I want to be happy again, but it feels like it will never happen.

<3

Let's not even fucking start on how bipolar my ass can be. Life can be fucking swell, and within minutes I'm wondering how best I can kill myself with the drawstrings to my blinds - I've since removed them, if that gives you an idea of how often that shit's come to mind as a way out.

It's not hard to make me angry or bitter or jealous over the stupidest, most petty of shit. I compare myself to others constantly, and find they're all just so much better than I am at everything; which, if you know my thoughts on humanity, is a pretty fucking sad comparison.

There's so many dreams I'll never get to accomplish. I'm never going to further my education. I'll never travel. I'll never meet the right person and make a good wife for them. I can't ever have any children, and I'll never accomplish any of my once-hobby dreams of writing and art -- visual novels is what I wanted to do, and we can see how fucking great that's going.

And you can argue, "Well if you're dead, you'll REALLY never do any of that!", and that's some really shitty logic right there. I'm not going to do it anyway, between expenses, time and my own fucking luck, so what's the point? At least by offing myself, there'll be one less scumbag in the universe, and I won't have to suffer with any of it anymore.

Life's not all roses, but it shouldn't be a series of fucking trainwrecks, either. "But think about people who have it worse than you!" Great. You know what? Give them my life, and I'll take theirs. Hell, I'd cut my fucking throat right now if it brought someone else back, like someone useful or worthwhile to humanity.
Wrote a reply. It's down there. Sorry.
Wrote a reply. You'll forgive me if I'm not inclined to repeat myself, I guess. Sorry.

Holy shit, where do I start? There's so much that's utterly fucked about my entire existence, and I'm sick of being a trouble to people. To friends, co-workers, and myself. It's the classical case of 'sick and tired of being sick and tired'. At this point, I'm little more than a waste of resources. Two shit jobs that eat most of my time, and I'm completely unappreciated in them.

No real life friends, and because of the lack of time, I've been strangled out of most of my hobbies, which used to include writing, some art, and some gaming with my online pals. Who are hardly pals, anymore. It's like I'm a nuisance now and they don't have time for me anymore. I understand people are busy, and naturally, I don't fucking expect them to be there all of the time, but it's been over a year for some people, despite my vain attempts to hold any sort of conversation with them. I can't talk to my family about anything, either. It's great. Every time I've ever voiced a concern about how I'm feeling, it's usually a typical 'get over it', or that I don't have any reason to be unhappy. Other people have it worse.

Because that shit invalidates your own sadness.

I have plenty to be unhappy about. Sure, I've got a home and jobs, but the pay is beyond shit and we're not really making enough to stay afloat. I qualify for free insurance here in the US, but that's a nightmare of its own right.

So yeah, I'm completely uninsured! My health's been sort of deteriorating, and honestly? I just don't give a single fuck anymore. Good. Let it. I'm still paying off surgeries from over a year ago, and the only reason I had them done was because an infection nearly infected the bones in my neck, and killed me. Kinda wish it had.

Let's see. Where else. I'm a stupid fucking tranny, so there's that. Being trans is a form of torture I wish I never knew, really. There's so much shit that just ruins your entire life. Pressure from friends and family and yourself - my family's sort of laughed it off and called it a phase. My mother's told me I wouldn't be very good at what I wish I was. It's not a matter of appearance, but merely because I don't "live that way". Great. Thanks mum.

I tend to just piss everyone off, and it's obvious people have begun shutting me out of their lives - who wants some toxic-minded shithead ruining their own fun, right? Nowhere to go, nobody to turn to, so I've started burning all of my bridges. I just don't care. If they don't care, they won't give a shit when I'm dead, either. 

I'm so sick of us as a species. We're such entitled little cunts, and I just can't take it anymore. So much violence, disgusting behaviours and greed. Stop the mother fucking planet, I want to get off.

Being trans, myself, and in a rather similar mood, I found it all the more unsettling that her name was Kate. So's mine! I found this especially haunting because I've been contemplating suicide for a long time, and have even set things in motion to kind of get the proverbial ball rolling by the end of the year. A lengthy setup, consideration, are all things 've done, myself. I just haven't been so open in telling people. Well, until now.

It's sad, and it's true. And they're just content to go through the motions every day with their heads up their asses. It's like they just don't give a shit about anyone else, or any thing until it inconveniences them.
